payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully

condition.question: Is her jacket fully closed?
condition.criteria: Compare the corresponding front closure areas of the same jacket in SOURCE and EDITED. Score concrete movement of the front panels toward each other as partial fulfillment when a visible opening remains; score full fulfillment only when the panels meet along the closure and no visible opening remains. If turning, draping, or occlusion prevents a reliable comparison of the closure areas, leave fulfillment unresolved rather than treating poor visibility as no progress or inferring progress from pose or motion.
condition.binding: Compare the jacket on the woman in SOURCE with the jacket on the woman in EDITED, focusing on corresponding visible portions of its front closure. Judge the requested endpoint as a fully closed jacket; distinguish visible partial closure from no change, and use insufficient evidence when the closure cannot be reliably compared.
condition.endpoint: Her jacket is fully closed, with no visible opening along the closure.
condition.necessity: This is the requested change and its complete endpoint.
condition.zero_when: The corresponding closure areas are sufficiently visible to compare, and the EDITED jacket shows no concrete movement of its front panels toward closure relative to SOURCE.
condition.half_when: The corresponding closure areas show concrete movement of the front panels toward each other relative to SOURCE, but a visible opening remains; if the closure cannot be reliably compared, leave the score unresolved instead of assigning partial fulfillment.
condition.full_when: The EDITED jacket’s front panels meet along the closure, with no visible opening remaining along it.
